why: A is pure linear algebra: rank of the last map of a finite exact sequence equals the alternating sum, and subadditivity of S_λ for any abstract LongExactSeq / FiltrationHomology of finite-dimensional spaces. B is subadditivity for actual singular homology of triples of subsets. A ⇒ B: apply LongExactSeq.altSum_le to the project's subsetTripleLongExactSeq (the topological input comes from the project, not from A). B ⇒ A is impossible in general: B speaks only about topological triples and cannot give the abstract statements about arbitrary exact sequences.
